scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,worker "npm run dev -w @thoughtfull/api" "npm run dev -w @thoughtfull/web" "npm run dev -w @thoughtfull/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @thoughtfull/shared && npm run build -w @thoughtfull/db && npm run build -w @thoughtfull/api && npm run build -w @thoughtfull/worker && npm run build -w @thoughtfull/web
scripts.predev: npm run build -w @thoughtfull/shared && npm run build -w @thoughtfull/db
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @thoughtfull/shared && npm run build -w @thoughtfull/db
scripts.pretypecheck: npm run build -w @thoughtfull/shared && npm run build -w @thoughtfull/db
scripts.pretest:e2e: npm run build -w @thoughtfull/shared && npm run build -w @thoughtfull/db
scripts.pretest:postgres: npm run build -w @thoughtfull/shared && npm run build -w @thoughtfull/db
scripts.build:services: npm run build -w @thoughtfull/shared && npm run build -w @thoughtfull/db && npm run build -w @thoughtfull/api && npm run build -w @thoughtfull/worker
scripts.dev:all: npm run build:services && concurrently -k -n api,web,worker "npm run start -w @thoughtfull/api" "npm run dev -w @thoughtfull/web" "npm run start -w @thoughtfull/worker"
